accident_report: V1 (car) is in Lane 3, traveling parallel to V3 (another car) which is in Lane 4. V2 (truck) is in Lane 2, approximately parallel to V1 initially. V1 intends to change lanes from Lane 3 to Lane 2 where V2 is traveling. V1 signals and starts to change lanes from Lane 3 to Lane 2. V2 in Lane 2 is traveling at a steady speed and does not notice V1's lane change until it is too late. V1 drifts out of Lane 3 and into Lane 2, but misjudges the distance or speed of V2. V1 sideswipes V2, causing a minor collision where both vehicles suffer some damage. V3 in Lane 4 continues traveling but might need to make a slight adjustment if V1 swerves back into Lane 3 after the sideswipe. The outcome is a sideswipe collision between V1 and V2. V3 continues traveling but might need to make a slight adjustment if V1 swerves back into Lane 3.
